leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to specify the props structure for a reusable StarRating component.
Implement useState hook to manage the active rating state within the component.
Apply array iteration to generate star elements based on a maximum rating value.
Utilize conditional rendering to display either filled or empty star icons.
Construct click event handlers to update the rating state when stars are clicked.
Use inline styles or CSS classes to visually represent the selected rating state.
Execute conditional logic to compare each star's index against the current rating for display decisions.
Return a structured JSX element containing the interactive star rating interface.
Control component behavior by passing and accessing props like maxStars and initialRating.
Invoke the StarRating component within a parent component with specific configuration props.
Modify the rating state in response to user interactions while maintaining TypeScript type safety.
Apply React component composition patterns to integrate the StarRating into a larger UI structure.
